problem: Hosts facing rejected damage/dispute evidence (14-day misses, shifting denial reasons)

product.title: Short-Term Rental Damage Claim Evidence Kit

rules_status: NOT machine-readable (JS-rendered); posture: help-first, link only if genuinely useful, expect strict moderation

candidates.draft: The causation fight is the hardest part. What worked for others: a dated baseline (pre-stay photos from the same positions every turnover) plus the guest message thread showing notice. Your appeal should foreground the loss-of-income angle the reps themselves mentioned, with booking records attached. I wrote up the full documentation method here [Telegraph link] after researching the April 2026 terms — disclosure: I also sell a $49 evidence-kit with the checklists if you want it done-for-you.

That 14-day window from checkout is the single most common denial reason — most hosts learn it exists the way you did. For this case, lead the appeal with everything timestamped you do have and be explicit about the 3-day delay reason. Going forward: a fixed photo set after every clean kills this entire failure mode. Method here [Telegraph link]; disclosure as above.

Shifting reasons usually means no single reviewer owned the file. Re-file as one organized batch: before/after photos, invoice on letterhead, ownership proof, message thread showing admission. Reference the April 2026 legitimate-and-verifiable-evidence standard explicitly. Full method [Telegraph link]; disclosure as above.

link_policy: Telegraph guide link only where contextually decisive; product link only if asked or explicitly permitted; never both unsolicited
disclosure: always state seller interest when linking own assets
fallback_no_links: post the core advice text only (deadlines + baseline method), no URLs

tracking.measurement: Gumroad dashboard reads (founder) + sales poll; Telegraph views; reply score/replies observed manually
tracking.limitation: no UTM guarantee on Gumroad; attribution is directional, not exact
